message.content:
This vertical-format editorial illustration shows a portrait of a smiling man, whose face is overlaid with the visual effect of shattered glass. He has short dark hair, brown eyes, and visible teeth with one tooth appearing dark. He wears a light green collared garment. A network of white, jagged cracks and irregular fragments of glass covers his face. The glass appears to originate from a central impact point on his forehead, radiating outward.

The red masthead "TEMPO" is at the top. Above it, the text reads "MAS JOKO DAN PUTRI SOLO" and "BAHAYA DI BALIK JAMU KUAT". Below the masthead, smaller text states "EDISI 18-24 FEBRUARI 2013". In the lower-right corner, large text in yellow and white reads "BURUK ANAS PARTAI DIBELAH". A vertical barcode and price information "RP 29.700" are on the lower-left edge. The background is solid white. A thick red border frames the left edge, and a thinner red strip is at the bottom. The overall image displays sharp lines and high contrast.
